name: ASSIST: the shared engine of every Assist app, downstream of TUFTE
asks:
This is new work but we wanna start making ASSIST, Agent-Supported Service Interface Simulating Topologies, a package downstream of TUFTE (Tiling User Form Topology Engine)

ASSIST is mean to be the shared engine for all our "* Assist" apps, that we have or have planned, and starting to get them all set up at https://whatever.assist.561.group I.e. eve.assist.561.group, gig.assist.561.group, etc.

This is part of one of our wys to align code with our best theory, and do our best to put pressure on our praxis driven development, market driven development theories, rendanheyi operations around huidu guanli hull, requirement management team, spec engineering teams, SAS, HLD, LLD, codegen codemod etc etc

There are probably other epic alignments you can see and imagine and realize using our best methods, continuing to get github, legacy, everything aligned as much as we can.

x-provenance.recorded-by: program-manager (bare-cedar-fog-claude, dispatched under the Leader standing direction of 2026-10-09)
x-provenance.basis: Opening prompt of the Leader on Bare Cedar Fog, carried as a requirement record by the board-requirement-intake skill. The raised-by field and asks are the Leader's own words; the requirements below are the program manager's EARS rendering of what those words ask, and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: One shared engine, ASSIST, built downstream of TUFTE, serves every Assist app the Group has or plans, each at its own host under assist.561.group.

requirements.says: The ASSIST package shall depend on the TUFTE package and carry no copy of its engine.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "a package downstream of TUFTE".

requirements.says: The ASSIST package shall be the one engine that every Assist app the Group has or plans runs on.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "the shared engine for all our '* Assist' apps, that we have or have planned".

requirements.says: Each Assist app shall be served at its own host under assist.561.group, starting with eve.assist.561.group and gig.assist.561.group.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "https://whatever.assist.561.group I.e. eve.assist.561.group, gig.assist.561.group, etc."

requirements.says: Each Assist app shall be a parameterization of ASSIST and carry no engine code of its own.
requirements.rationale: Rule science-engineering-operations-parameterize-in-order; the program manager's immunity: refuse a second app where a parameterization serves.

requirements.says: The ASSIST package shall be fabricated from a requirements specification, a SAS, an HLD and an LLD, in that order.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "requirement management team, spec engineering teams, SAS, HLD, LLD, codegen codemod".

requirements.says: The ASSIST package shall realize the Group's existing assist application platform specification and its muse-assist implementation, not a second specification.
requirements.rationale: Rule use-and-improve-the-groups-own-software; the 2026-09-11 specification (v0.3.0) names EVE, Alpaca, Gig and Redshirt Assist.

requirements.says: The ASSIST package shall serve each qualifying service's operation to humans from the same declaration the x402 market sells it to agents from.
requirements.rationale: The Leader (~01:00Z, 2026-10-09): "serving micro-SaaSes to humans, the way x402 is for agents".

requirements.says: The ASSIST package shall return one Fetch handler per Assist instance, served by a Cloudflare Worker face and by a MetroPlat face.
requirements.rationale: The 2026-09-11 engine is a Worker and muse-assist is a MetroPlat instance; one engine for both.

requirements.says: Each Assist app with a prior host (eve-assist, alpaca-assist, kalshi-assist, rail-assist, redshirt-assist, muse.561.group) shall answer that host with a permanent redirect to its host under assist.561.group.
requirements.rationale: The Leader (2026-09-12) named redshirt-assist.561.group and (2026-10-04) kalshi-assist.561.group; (2026-10-09) whatever.assist.561.group.

requirements.says: The ASSIST package shall execute an operation in simulation with its effects withheld and label its result as simulated.
requirements.rationale: The name: Service Interface Simulating Topologies; the Leader (2026-10-04): Kalshi Assist's own UX "as ... holofoam".

requirements.says: An Assist instance that names a parent instance shall inherit every field of the parent that it does not override, and its host label chain shall mirror its parent chain.

conditions.says: The ASSIST package depends on TUFTE.
The engine exists as one package.
A SAS exists beside the HLD and LLD.
The ASSIST package specification exists at the section and cites the Leader's utterances.

board-opening.context: The Leader frames this as one of the ways to align code with the best theory (praxis-driven and market-driven development, Rendanheyi operations under the Huidu Guanli hull, the requirement management and specification engineering teams). The home is the TUFTE app's section because ASSIST is downstream of it. The 2026-10-09 burndown names the existing specification (v0.3.0) and the muse-assist start; it is the prior session's sheet, pasted by the Leader, and is source material for R6 only.

sources.words: we wanna start making ASSIST, Agent-Supported Service Interface Simulating Topologies, a package downstream of TUFTE (Tiling User Form Topology Engine) ... ASSIST is mean to be the shared engine for all our "* Assist" apps ... https://whatever.assist.561.group I.e. eve.assist.561.group, gig.assist.561.group
we can also *turn* more things into assist apps ... a whole 561-group service to turn qualifying services into assist apps for the public

Another thing we planned out but didn't get done as well as i want is developing our ASSIST app, downstream of our web platform, and then regrounding more on ASSIST; we talked about it as a way of serving micro-SaaSes to humans, the way x402 is for agents.
We want to prepare for a new Assist application for our web platform, for Target employees, at https://redshirt-assist.561.group
we can start earning our way toward a https://kalshi-assist.561.group app the way we have other assist apps, offering a like, our own UX for navigating Kalshi as - your'e gonna love this, holofoam

x-provenance.not-held: The ASSIST package is specified (2026-10-10) and not fabricated; no assist.561.group host is held; the Assist apps exist as the 2026-09-11 engine, EVE Assist on it, muse-assist on MetroPlat, and seats.
x-provenance.unresolved-authority: None. The outcome is the owning section's to realize; acceptance is the assayer's.
